summary: @oer_cameroon If you want to get involved in what the @goifoundation is doing please do! We had to find a $200 US sponsor, but that was enough to launch a pilot for quite a few folks. I can't fundraise but happy to help if you jump on board. #oer19 #oer

body_html:
@oer_cameroon If you want to get involved in what the @goifoundation is doing please do! We had to find a $200 US sponsor, but that was enough to launch a pilot for quite a few folks.
I can't fundraise but happy to help if you jump on board. #oer19 #oer
